Likely Average in general (Superboy-Prime achieved a high school-level education, but his increasing psychosis has left him childlike and unstable, often making irrational decisions and coming up with childish retorts and taunts on a regular basis and entering psychotic tantrums whenever he is slighted) Genius in terms of scientific prowess (Was able to create a solar-absorbing armor which collects yellow sunlight and feeds it to him. He is fairly skilled at hand-to-hand combat and has full mastery of his powers, allowing him to overpower most opponents simply by attacking them repeatedly with his overwhelming brute strength)

He is susceptible to red sunlight (though the Anti-Monitor armor negates this weakness). He has an innate fear of the Flashes due to being sealed in the Speed Force for a significant amount of time. Superboy-Prime is dangerously psychotic and insane, and will act irrationally at the slightest provocation. Feats: * Killed 30 Green Lanterns * Tanked punches from Bart Allen after the latter absorbed the entirety of the speed force. * Punched through the body of a weakened Anti-Monitor and tossing the rest of his body into space * Defeated people such as Ion (Sodam Yat), Black Adam, Wonder Woman, Martian Manhunter, Power Girl, Superman, and his counterparts in Infinite Crisis. * During the Sinestro Corps War, it took a Guardian of the Universe to defeat him, sacrificing himself by releasing all the energy contained in his body. All the Oan energy released by the Guardian ended up being absorbed by Superman-Prime making him even more powerful. With that power, he tortured Mr. Mxyzptlk and survived an explosion powerful enough to destroy the universe during his fight with Monarch, a cosmic being who fought and defeated numerous counterparts of Captain Atom simultaneously and Superman and attempted to conquer the Multiverse in Countdown to Final Crisis. * After losing the Oan energy and being transported to the 30th Century, he proceeded to tank an attack from Mordru and take on the Legion of Super-Heroes with ease. Notes: *Superboy-Prime originally appeared during the Crisis on Infinite Earths and was portrayed as roughly on par with Superman and other Pre-Crisis Kryptonians, but since he was taken to a pocket dimension outside of the conventional multiverse after battling the Anti-Monitor, his feats, power, and continuity were not rebooted like most other Pre-Crisis characters. *Do not scale Superboy-Prime from his fight with The Darkest Knight. He had no official reason for such a ridiculously extreme power-up, has no feats of his own anywhere near approaching this scale, and needed help to even accomplish a planetary feat right previously in the Death Metal storyline.Dark Nights: Death Metal Vol 1 5 There was no logical reason for him to suddenly gain so much power other than extreme plot convention. Also skilled in the usage of gunsDark Nights: Metal Ch 4), Acrobatics (Even without the empowerment of Nth Metal, she could easily perform acrobatic jumps in the middle of intense fights), Vehicular Mastery (Piloted a ship when sunk to microscopic sizes to protect Martian Manhunter's nervous systemJustice League Vol 4 3), Flight and Spaceflight (Shown hereJustice League Vol 4 65), Energy Manipulation and Absorption (Nth Metal works by conducting mystical energyDark Days: The Forge. It can absorb energy attacks and be used to strike back with the same powerDark Nights: Metal Ch 5), Regeneration (Low-Mid. Carter Hall's body heals faster thanks to the Nth Metal's properties, quickly healing all wounds he'd suffered at the hands of Hawkwoman, and Kendra should share this ability as it is bestowed by his Nth MetalHawkman Vol 5 19), Vibration Manipulation (Nth Metal can cause shockwaves when clashing with other Nth MetalHawkman Vol 5 27), limited Physics Manipulation (Structures built of Nth Metal are said to defy the laws of physicsJustice League Vol 4 14), Non-Physical Interaction (Nth Metal can hurt ghostsBatman Eternal 24), Invulnerability Negation (Nth Metal is one of the only things that can nullify the invulnerability of Dark Multiverse beingsDark Nights: Metal Ch 3), Regeneration Nullification (High-Mid. The Nth metal prevented some alien creatures from regenerating, whereas previously they could grow back from just a detached head.Savage Hawkman Vol 1 1 This nullification happens on the cellular levelSavage Hawkman Vol 1 2), Limited Power Nullification (Nth Metal caused Morphicius' teleportation to fail, and then he used it to hinder Katar's flight abilities. It also cancelled a century-long spellSavage Hawkman Vol 1 6), Limited Empowerment (The Nth Metal armor allowed Katar Hol to fight even when he'd otherwise collapse.Savage Hawkman Vol 1 10 It is also the source of Hawkgirl's superhuman strength), Resistance to Poison Manipulation, Mind Manipulation and Morality Manipulation (Hawkgirl overcame a dose of Joker's venom.Justice League Vol 4 6 Carter's Nth Armor slowed down the effect of The Batman Who Laughs's venom meant to turn him evilHawkman Vol 5 20 by suppressing his consciousness in favor of Sky Tyrant'sHawkman Vol 5 21 and eventually overpowered itHawkman Vol 5 23), Disease Manipulation (Former incarnations of Hawkgirl as well as Hawkman's were immune to the plague), Life Manipulation and Absorption (Absorbing Hawkgirl's life essence is painful and difficult because of the Nth Metal's properties. Also, each of the many reincarnations she lived through resides within her, and will be affected before he isHawkman Vol 5 26), Telepathy and Mind Manipulation (Was trained by Martian Manhunter to resist mental attacksJustice League Vol 4 56)

At least Town level (Comparable to Hawkwoman,Justice League Vol 4 15 who defeated Sky Tyrant who caused a shockwave of this size, albeit she lost to her when she had the help of a failed copy of Katar HolJustice League Vol 4 16), Low Complex Multiverse level at peak (Fought Lex Luthor's warsuit.Justice League Vol 4 7 Hurt an off-guard Martian Manhunter.Justice League Vol 4 9 Seemingly injured Gorilla Grodd.Justice League Vol 4 57 Hurt Zumbado, a being who could contend with Black Adam and Aquaman and is an enemy of Naomi.Justice League Vol 4 59 Comparable to Katar HolThe Savage Hawkman Vol 1 15)
Massively FTL+

At least Town level, Low Complex Multiverse level with Nth Metal (Nth Metal is superior to the Eight Metal that gods use for their weapons and armor, such as those used by Wonder Woman. However do note that Hawkgirl's armor only offers partial protection from attacks of comparable foes)
At least Peak Human. Capable of fighting through long battles, and her Nth Metal can allow her to fight even when she'd normally collapse.
Extended Melee Range, Tens of Meters by throwing her mace
Nth Metal Armor and Mace, Optional
Gifted. A skilled combatant who brings the experience of many of her previous incarnations into battle.
At least 9-A with her weaker animal powers, up to 5-A at her absolute strongest

Superhuman Physical Characteristics to varying degrees with different animal powers (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability), Superhuman Athleticism (Can use her heightened speed from Cheetah Power to make massive superhuman leaps. However, even without building up speed, it seems as if Vixen can leap higher than any IRL human can even without Cheetah Power, as in one instance she leapt from ground level to the top of a tree branch), Enhanced Senses (Wields infra-red vision with her Lizard Power), Acrobatics (Performed acrobatic leaps and flips in order to intercept Green Lantern. Did what seems to be a quintuple somersault while scaling a cliff-face. Backflipped to avoid an explosion), Natural Weaponry (Conventional: Some of her animal powers, like her Puma Power, give her claws she can use in combat), Combat Expertise (Shows proficiency with her powers during her many fights in JLU, and in CQC uses a kick and bodyslam-focused style. Judo-threw Wonder Woman, using the Amazing Amazon's own attack momentum against her), Electricity Manipulation (with her Electric Eel Power, which covers her in bioelectricity that shocks foes upon contact), Regeneration (At least Low: Used a reptile's healing power to instantly heal a broken arm), Surface Scaling (with her Spider Power, which allows her to adhere to surfaces and scale them with inhuman agility), Weight Manipulation (Can give herself the mass of an elephant with her Elephant Power), Limited, Resistance to Fire Manipulation (Was unburnt, if staggered, by Dreamslayer's flame)

At least Small Building Level with her weaker animal powers (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Restrained Hawkgirl with a boa-constrictor bind and beat Paran Dul, an adult female Thanagarian Soldier of a similar rank to Hawkgirl, in a fistfight. Knocked over Tracer and knocked him out with a boa-constrictor choke, with Tracer being capable of tackling Batman and hurting him with a punch. Fought and notably pressed Black Canary. Clawed through the base of a statue. Cratered a metal wall by kicking a Thanagarian into it. Burst through an elevator door. Slashed through a Dark Heart Drone, which could tank machine gun fire), up to Large Planet Level at her absolute strongest (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Using an unknown animal power, Vixen contributed to a combo attack which overtly harmed Overman. Dented the arm of a battle suit (which was presumably made of Nth Metal, considering it was a Thanagarian weapon) with a kick. Briefly stopped Wonder Woman from attacking Hawkgirl. Fought Shadow Thief and smacked him around. Knocked Chaos-Magic Solomon Grundy through a few walls with an elephant charge, but seemingly did no actual damage and had to take him off-guard to knock him over in the first place)

Relativistic+ combat speed and reactions with most of her animal powers (Scaling to 0.53c - Comparable in speed to a bloodlusted, mind-controlled Wonder Woman, expertly evading her stomp attack and turning aside her charging punch - on another occasion, Vixen and a furious WW were shown to attack Overman in perfect sync. Can fight Shadow Thief, dodging his attacks and tagging him with tackles and kicks, with Shadow Thief being capable of dodging Lantern Beams (which are SoL) after they were fired - on that note, Vixen could duck to avoid a Lantern Beam after it was fired), Peak Human charging speed with Elephant Power (Overtly depicted as notably slower than her Base Self), and up to Subsonic running speed with Cheetah Power (Cheetahs can achieve running speeds of up to 128 km/h)

Varies (The extent to which her animal powers modify her durability is difficult to ascertain, but her durability is undeniably inconsistent in a similar way as Hawkgirl's), from at least Small Building Level (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should scale to her own AP as per Newton's Third Law. Was harmed by, but took, attacks from Black Canary. Withstood slamming into a seating section hard enough to shatter a sizable portion of it. Tanked a flame blast that sent her through the side of a large truck. Was hurt by a bookcase falling on her. Was KO-ed by a dinosaur skeleton falling on her from a great height), to as high as Large Planet Level (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Tanked a Canary Cry, which destroyed something that swings from Hawkgirl's mace couldn't, though the CC being that powerful isn't consistent, and it's also implied that Vixen would have died if Hawkgirl had hit her in the head with her mace. Stayed conscious after an elbow strike from Wonder Woman, but another strike KO-ed her)

Presumably has normal human weaknesses, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. Ergo

At least 9-A with her weaker animal powers, up to 5-A at her absolute strongest

Superhuman Physical Characteristics to varying degrees with different animal powers (See Attack Potency, Speed, Lifting Strength, and Durability), Superhuman Athleticism (Can use her heightened speed from Cheetah Power to make massive superhuman leaps. However, even without building up speed, it seems as if Vixen can leap higher than any IRL human can even without Cheetah Power, as in one instance she leapt from ground level to the top of a tree branch), Enhanced Senses (Wields infra-red vision with her Lizard Power), Acrobatics (Performed acrobatic leaps and flips in order to intercept Green Lantern. Did what seems to be a quintuple somersault while scaling a cliff-face. Backflipped to avoid an explosion), Natural Weaponry (Conventional: Some of her animal powers, like her Puma Power, give her claws she can use in combat), Combat Expertise (Shows proficiency with her powers during her many fights in JLU, and in CQC uses a kick and bodyslam-focused style. Judo-threw Wonder Woman, using the Amazing Amazon's own attack momentum against her), Electricity Manipulation (with her Electric Eel Power, which covers her in bioelectricity that shocks foes upon contact), Regeneration (At least Low: Used a reptile's healing power to instantly heal a broken arm), Surface Scaling (with her Spider Power, which allows her to adhere to surfaces and scale them with inhuman agility), Weight Manipulation (Can give herself the mass of an elephant with her Elephant Power), Limited, Resistance to Fire Manipulation (Was unburnt, if staggered, by Dreamslayer's flame)

At least Small Building Level with her weaker animal powers (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Restrained Hawkgirl with a boa-constrictor bind and beat Paran Dul, an adult female Thanagarian Soldier of a similar rank to Hawkgirl, in a fistfight. Knocked over Tracer and knocked him out with a boa-constrictor choke, with Tracer being capable of tackling Batman and hurting him with a punch. Fought and notably pressed Black Canary. Clawed through the base of a statue. Cratered a metal wall by kicking a Thanagarian into it. Burst through an elevator door. Slashed through a Dark Heart Drone, which could tank machine gun fire), up to Large Planet Level at her absolute strongest (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Using an unknown animal power, Vixen contributed to a combo attack which overtly harmed Overman. Dented the arm of a battle suit (which was presumably made of Nth Metal, considering it was a Thanagarian weapon) with a kick. Briefly stopped Wonder Woman from attacking Hawkgirl. Fought Shadow Thief and smacked him around. Knocked Chaos-Magic Solomon Grundy through a few walls with an elephant charge, but seemingly did no actual damage and had to take him off-guard to knock him over in the first place)

Relativistic+ combat speed and reactions with most of her animal powers (Scaling to 0.53c - Comparable in speed to a bloodlusted, mind-controlled Wonder Woman, expertly evading her stomp attack and turning aside her charging punch - on another occasion, Vixen and a furious WW were shown to attack Overman in perfect sync. Can fight Shadow Thief, dodging his attacks and tagging him with tackles and kicks, with Shadow Thief being capable of dodging Lantern Beams (which are SoL) after they were fired - on that note, Vixen could duck to avoid a Lantern Beam after it was fired), Peak Human charging speed with Elephant Power (Overtly depicted as notably slower than her Base Self), and up to Subsonic running speed with Cheetah Power (Cheetahs can achieve running speeds of up to 128 km/h)

Varies (The extent to which her animal powers modify her durability is difficult to ascertain, but her durability is undeniably inconsistent in a similar way as Hawkgirl's), from at least Small Building Level (Upscaling from 0.095 Tons - Should scale to her own AP as per Newton's Third Law. Was harmed by, but took, attacks from Black Canary. Withstood slamming into a seating section hard enough to shatter a sizable portion of it. Tanked a flame blast that sent her through the side of a large truck. Was hurt by a bookcase falling on her. Was KO-ed by a dinosaur skeleton falling on her from a great height), to as high as Large Planet Level (Downscaling from 1.03 Ronnatons - Tanked a Canary Cry, which destroyed something that swings from Hawkgirl's mace couldn't, though the CC being that powerful isn't consistent, and it's also implied that Vixen would have died if Hawkgirl had hit her in the head with her mace. Stayed conscious after an elbow strike from Wonder Woman, but another strike KO-ed her)

Presumably has normal human weaknesses, with the only tie in comics that have statements to the contrary (other than Batman: The Adventures Continue, which has so many continuity issues that it's essentially impossible to argue it's canon) being Justice League Infinity, the Batman and Harley Quinn tie in comics, and specifically the first annual of Batman Adventures. field_candidates.value: Superhuman Physical Characteristics, Enhanced Senses, Self-Sustenance (Type 1; Can breathe in the vacuum of space Harley Quinn Vol 3 #67 ), Martial Arts (Is a professional wrestler capable of contesting other wrestlers), Acrobatics, Weapon Mastery (Harley has shown proficiency with all sorts of weapons, from assault rifles to plungers and toiletry's to large hammers and more), Multiple Personalities (Shown here and here), Fourth Wall Awareness (Is capable of reading the comics she's in Harley Quinn Vol 3 #64 as well as speaking to the reader directly on multiple occasionsHarley Quinn Vol 3 #70 ), Immortality Negation (Type 7; Can kill the Coney Island Zombies), Genius Intelligence (Extraordinary Genius), Chaos Manipulation, Order Manipulation (As the Angel of Retribution was stated to have the power of both the Lord of Chaos and the Lord of Order Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66), Reality Warping, Plot Manipulation (Wields the power of continuity stating that specific symbols will appear at the end of every comic and receiving notifications during crossover events, she is also the narrator for a large portion of her stories addressing the reader as "dreamers, hustlers, and schemers" Harley Quinn Vol 3 #66 Harley Quinn Vol 3 #71; Harley was capable of accidentally destroying all of DC Continuity to a greater degree than that of the Milk Wars Harley Quinn Vol 3 #50 ), possesses the red-black lantern ring, briefly the green lantern ring, Pain Manipulation, Memory Manipulation, Dimensional Travel, Portal Creation (As Hammer Harleen, her hammer contains a mother box which can torture one-thousand people at once, force her to focus on a single memory, as well as create boom-tubes allowing her to teleport from place to place), Indomitable Will (Was unphased after having 94-thousand different calculations on how to break her personality), Resistance to Madness Manipulation (Could look into Johnny Sorrows face which is stated to be the true face of madness), Plot Manipulation (Was unaffected by the final wave which wiped DC's Continuity),

Universe Level+ (Was capable of harming both the Lords of Chaos and Order whom are said to be as strong as the entire universe) | Outerverse Level (Was capable of knocking out Rebirth Hal Jordan who should be comparable to his Post-Crisis self; On multiple occasions can damage and combat the new god Granny Goodness, depowered she can also tank hits from her) | High Outerverse Level (Was capable of shattering DC's continuity which is stated to be the force keeping all of reality from spinning out of control and its stated that when Harley did this it was worse than The Milk Wars caused by the Retcon Corp, and afterwards sent waves across continuity strong enough to completely destroy DC's continuity as well as beings such as the Anti-Monitor)
MFTL+ likely Immeasurable Speed (Comparable in speed to Rebirth Hal Jordan) | Irrelevant Speed (Can exist and move at the end of continuity)
Star Level (Tanked having a sun thrown at her) | High Outerverse Level (Survived the final wave which destroyed all of DC's Continuity)

attack_potency.text: Solar System level (Comparable to Orion's Post-Flashpoint Avatar as well as Kryptonians such as Superman, Zod and Faora. Defeated Supergirl in combat. Stated by Parasite to hold "more power than Superman". Destroyed Hal Jordan's construct and fought with Yellow Lanterns. Her sword could pierce Doomsday, but that could be an example of Durability Negation)

speed.text: At least Massively FTL+ (Comparable to Kryptonians, such as Superman, Zod and Faora, faster than Supergirl in combat)

lifting_strength.text: Class M (Along with Superman, lifted an aircraft carrierJustice League 2011 #15)

striking_strength.text: Solar System level (Same as her Attack Potency)

durability.text: Solar System level (Has survived blows from Superman, Supergirl, Zod, Faora and Doomsday). Her Bracelets of Submission can endure Darkseid's Omega Beams

stamina.text: Superhuman | Superhuman (Had to gather more Anti-Crisis Energy from the multiverse each time her Anti-Crisis Energy ran out)

range.text: Standard Melee Range, Extended Melee Range with her sword and lasso | High Outerversal

intelligence.text: Genius (Diana possesses great wisdom and intelligence. She is among the smartest and wisest members of the Justice League, along with the Martian Manhunter and Batman. Master Combatant. Stated by Ares to have, even as a child, "Skills that rival those of Ulysses and Achilles combined")

claims.text: Solar System level (Comparable to Orion's Post-Flashpoint Avatar as well as Kryptonians such as Superman, Zod and Faora. Defeated Supergirl in combat. Stated by Parasite to hold "more power than Superman". Destroyed Hal Jordan's construct and fought with Yellow Lanterns. Her sword could pierce Doomsday, but that could be an example of Durability Negation) | Solar System level (Stated by Cheetah to be stronger than before. Restrained God of Strength Superman with her lasso and damaged him with her sword) | At least Solar System level (Stomped ArtemisWonder Woman 2011 #12, who was previously capable of briefly fight on par with Wonder Woman, and gave her a much harder timeWonder Woman 2011 #20. Could briefly wrestle with Superman DoomSuperman/Wonder Woman Annual #9) | Low Complex Multiverse level (Upscales from her Post-Crisis self. Drew blood from LoboDC K.O.: Wonder Woman vs. Lobo (2026) #1. Fought against SupergirlWonder Woman (2016) #47. Comparable to Rebirth Superman) | High Outerverse level (After combining her Lasso of Truth to the Element X in the World Forge, she was able to create a link between everyone and history, creating a stream of Anti-Crisis Energy that made her strong enough to fight the Darkest Knight.Dark Nights: Death Metal Vol 1 7)

Wields a katana in 4GO), Adept in martial arts, Transformation (Into White Sister Rom with HDD [Hard Drive Divinity]), Fourth Wall Awareness, Acrobatics, Healing (Transforming into her goddess form fully restores her HP and SP. Also with "I'll Heal You" and "You're Okay"), Acausality (Types 1, 3, and 4; Was unaffected by having the entirety of Hyper Dimension's history itself being rewritten and even normal citizens kept their memories after the world was rewritten. It's explained by Histoire that time and causality splits people's past and future into multiple timelines to protect them from paradoxes and causal changes), Flight, Immortality (Types 1, 3, 4, 8; As a goddess, Rom cannot age, as age does not apply to goddesses. The Player can simply resurrect her or reload a save file if she loses at all. CPUs are reliant upon Share Energy and so long as there are shares, they can indefinitely revive themselves. Auto-Raise [should have it from scaling to Neptune] automatically resurrects her whenever she dies or is knocked out in battle.), Large Size (Type 11), Beyond-Dimensional Physiology (As with all other entities in the Neptunia series, her existence is beyond the concept of numerical dimensionality, as all beings evolved alongside Gamindustri into beyond dimensional existences), Fate and Plot Manipulation (Passive; Scaling from Neptune, as any protagonists should have it based on Neptune's statements and showings [Rom was one of the protagonists for a period of time in Megadimension]. Should have similar capabilities to that of Blanc and Noire, whom prevented a boss battle so the player didn't have to waste their time with it), Forcefield Creation, Self-Sustenance (Types 1, 2, and likely 3; CPUs have repeatedly displayed a lack of need for breathing in several continuities. As noted and displayed in Victory/RB3, CPUs do not require sustenance to stay alive and cannot starve to death. CPUs can remain in active combat with no rest for billions of years with no sign of tiredness, as displayed in the original Hyperdimension Neptunia, where the four CPUs have fought for eons.), Abstract Existence (Type 2; Goddesses are born from and are embodiments of Share Energy and won't perish so long as they have it), Conceptual Manipulation (Share Energy wielders can freely manipulate it to their whim. Share Energy is directly stated to be the concepts of will, faith, emotion, and desire. Share Energy can erase the true form of the Deity of Sin from existence by killing its manifestation, with the True Deity of Sin being abstract and conceptual in nature.), Hammerspace, Blessed (The Player can grant her the ability to One Shot opponents, give her Invulnerability, and/or weaken the opponent), Share Energy Manipulation (Lower End Applications), Information Analysis (The Observation Scope and Analyser allow her to analyze information of a foe, including but not limited to: heart rate, temperature, item drops, held items, health, stamina, statistics, and resistances), Weapon Creation (Can create her weapons out of nothing on the fly in just a couple of seconds), Extrasensory Perception (Can sense various forms of energy, including share energy and negative energy), Positive Emotion Empowerment (As a goddess she gains strength from share energy, which is consistently regarded to as positive emotions like hopes, desires, prayers, and faith. Share energy has also been referred to as the opposite to negative energy.), Non-Physical Interaction (Regular enemies include ghosts and beings made of data), Durability Negation, Damage Boost (Via Critical hits), Enhanced Senses (Sneaking Eye shows what the enemies can see), Perception Manipulation (Thanks to the White Orb, enemies won't attack unless they're attacked first), Regeneration (High-Godly; She can passively heal off damage from the remade Dark CPUs, which have Conceptual Manipulation due to possessing the abilities of the Next Form users.), Status Effect Inducement (In the form of Paralysis, Poison and Power Nullification), Magic (via various attacks), Elemental Manipulation (Of Water, Fire, Ice, Electricity, Earth, Poison, Air, Light, and Darkness through various attacks. She has the option of infusing one or more of these elements into her every attack [Scaling off of Neptune].), Absolute Zero Ice (Was taught to use Absolute Zero ice attacks by her older sister), Limiter Removal (Through Game Discs or The Player), Power Modification (With patches, which can modify what type of damage her weapon does), Glyph Creation, Resurrection (When she is knocked out or killed, she can resurrect via Auto-Raise. Also via "Come Back" and "Energy!"), Power Bestowal (everyone in RB2's ending gave their powers to Nepgear to fight the Deity of Sin.), Energy Manipulation and Projection (via various attacks), Life Manipulation (With the Dark Ring, Rom can manipulate the life force of all creatures),

Pinpoint high intensity sound waves can disrupt a Viltrumite's inner ears and highly sensitize equilibrium, disrupting their flight, causing intense pain or potentially death. The Scourge Virus is a specially engineered virus that infects Viltrumites and severely hampers their strength and invulnerability, usually resulting in death. At least Average (Possesses high school level education) At least Gifted (Has fought on par with and come out on top against several different Viltrumites, which are a race of aliens possessing thousands of years of combat experience, proficiency in martial arts techniques and melee weapon usage, and have ample experience fighting as well as overtaking various different alien civilizations, including Thragg, who in turn matched Battle Beast. He also demonstrates the ability to learn and adapt his approach during high-pressure battles. This skill eventually allows him to overcome other Viltrumite warriors, like Conquest, by using his arrogance and predictability against him, he stops holding back and eventually choking him to death. While his brawling style made him a reckless but effective fighter, he later grows to become a competent commander who leads the Combined Coalition forces to victory against Thragg’s ranks and manages to outmaneuver alien diplomats. Yet, despite his tactical brilliance, Mark’s tactical prowess is often undermined by his rash decisions and overall lack of emotional control. He is manipulated by Cecil Stedman more than once, becomes a victim of Robot’s scheme, and is constantly in danger of his moral fiber being compromised due to his adherence to his personal code, such as when he allowed Angstrom Levy and later Dinosaurus to live, with disastrous consequences for Earth’s security)

The Smart Atoms of Viltrumites cannot withstand high temperatures for long periods of time, with prolonged exposure weakening their durability as the atomic bonds are ripped apart. Pinpoint high intensity sound waves can disrupt a Viltrumite's inner ears and highly sensitize equilibrium, disrupting their flight, causing intense pain or potentially death. The Scourge Virus is a specially engineered virus that infects Viltrumites and severely hampers their strength and invulnerability, usually resulting in death. The Klaxus Plant will poison and weaken the species. Mark is strongly against killing and tends to hold back against opponents, regardless of the danger they pose to him and others due to fear that he'll accidentally kill them. Gifted (Negan is depicted as a highly intelligent character in the series. He demonstrates a keen strategic mind, particularly in his ability to lead and maintain control over the Saviors, a large and formidable group that imposes its will on other communities through fear and coercion. He is adept at using psychological tactics to assert dominance and loyalty among his followers. Has a profound understanding of human psychology, which he exploits to manipulate individuals and situations to his advantage. He is skilled at reading people, understanding their motivations, and using this knowledge to influence or control them. Negan's intelligence is also evident in his resourcefulness and adaptability. He is capable of making the most out of difficult situations, using whatever resources are available to secure advantages for himself and his group. His charisma and leadership are partially rooted in his intelligence. Negan knows how to inspire fear, respect, and even loyalty among his followers. He uses a combination of force, persuasion, and incentives to maintain order and discipline within the Saviors. He is adept at planning and executing attacks against other groups. He understands the importance of psychological warfare and uses it effectively against his enemies, often employing brutal tactics to instill fear and submission. Throughout the series, Negan shows an ability to adapt to changing circumstances and to learn from his mistakes. This adaptability is a testament to his intelligence, as he is constantly reassessing his strategies and approaches in light of new information)

Large Star level + (Canonically fought Mean Supreme to a stalemate which ended in a double knockout. Mean Supreme was powerful enough to destroy Planet Khromium with ease. Mean Supreme is also far stronger than Suprema, who could knit a black hole closed, or "play kick-ball with a star". This fight is canon as Omni-Man and Supreme have known each other for a while. ) Destroyed Viltrum along with Thaddeus, Invincible and Space Racer's Gun . Scales to Viltrumite War Invincible who can overpower Conquest. For context, Conquest was able to destroy the Coalition of Planets spaceship, which held a canon that destroyed the Sun Disk blocking all heat to the Rognarr's planet, creating a ice age. The spaceship would need to be tough enough to withstand its own recoil energy. Stronger than the average Viltrumite.)

Massively FTL+ (Flew from Earth to the Virgo Supercluster within a week, able to hold his own against Thragg who could react to his flight-speed. Also fought with Post-Power Up Allen, who could dodge Viltrumite ships and has his reaction speed canonically proportional to how fast he is moving at the moment)

Large Star level + (Survived slamming into Viltrum hard enough to destroy it. Should scale to Conquest who destroyed the Coalition spaceship which held a canon that destroyed the Sun Disk, survived a beat-down from Thragg. Wuthstood a hoarde of Thraxan/Viltrumite hybrids slamming into him without sustaining damage. An average Viltrumite is this strong. )

The Smart Atoms of a Viltrumite cannot withstand high temperatures for long periods of time, with prolonged exposure heavily weakening their strength and durability as the atomic bonds are ripped apart. Pinpoint high frequency sound waves can disrupt a Viltrumite's inner ears and highly sensitize equilibrium, disrupting their flight, causing intense pain or potentially death. The Scourge Virus is a specially engineered virus that infects Viltrumites and severely hampers their strength and invulnerability, usually resulting in death. The Klaxus Plant will poison and weaken the species. Rognarr are an alien species that evolved on a planet of such high gravity that they needed denser muscle tissue just to survive and move. These aliens are capable of easily killing and severely injuring the strongest of Viltrumites. == Notable Matchups == Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: == References == Category:Tier 4 Category:Tier High 4-C Category:CerberusTheDamned

The Smart Atoms of Viltrumites cannot withstand high temperatures for long periods of time, with prolonged exposure weakening their durability as the atomic bonds are ripped apart. Pinpoint high frequency sound waves can disrupt a Viltrumite's inner ears and highly sensitize equilibrium, disrupting their flight, causing intense pain or potentially death. The Scourge Virus is a specially engineered virus that infects Viltrumites and severely hampers their strength and invulnerability, usually resulting in death. Name: Nowl-Ahn, Nolan Grayson, Omni-Man Origin: Invincible Gender: Male Age: At least 2000 Classification: Alien (Viltrumite)
High 4-C

Large Star level + (Canonically fought Mean Supreme to a stalemate which ended in a double knockout. Mean Supreme was powerful enough to destroy Planet Khromium with ease. Mean Supreme is also far stronger than Suprema, who could knit a black hole closed, or "play kick-ball with a star". This fight is canon as Omni-Man and Supreme have known each other for a while. ) Destroyed Viltrum along with Thaddeus, Invincible and Space Racer's Gun . Scales to Viltrumite War Invincible who can overpower Conquest. For context, Conquest was able to destroy the Coalition of Planets spaceship, which held a canon that destroyed the Sun Disk blocking all heat to the Rognarr's planet, creating a ice age. The spaceship would need to be tough enough to withstand its own recoil energy. Stronger than the average Viltrumite.)

Massively FTL+ (Flew from Earth to the Virgo Supercluster within a week, able to hold his own against Thragg who could react to his flight-speed. Also fought with Post-Power Up Allen, who could dodge Viltrumite ships and has his reaction speed canonically proportional to how fast he is moving at the moment)

Large Star level + (Survived slamming into Viltrum hard enough to destroy it. Should scale to Conquest who destroyed the Coalition spaceship which held a canon that destroyed the Sun Disk, survived a beat-down from Thragg. Wuthstood a hoarde of Thraxan/Viltrumite hybrids slamming into him without sustaining damage. An average Viltrumite is this strong. )

The Smart Atoms of a Viltrumite cannot withstand high temperatures for long periods of time, with prolonged exposure heavily weakening their strength and durability as the atomic bonds are ripped apart. Pinpoint high frequency sound waves can disrupt a Viltrumite's inner ears and highly sensitize equilibrium, disrupting their flight, causing intense pain or potentially death. The Scourge Virus is a specially engineered virus that infects Viltrumites and severely hampers their strength and invulnerability, usually resulting in death. The Klaxus Plant will poison and weaken the species. Rognarr are an alien species that evolved on a planet of such high gravity that they needed denser muscle tissue just to survive and move. These aliens are capable of easily killing and severely injuring the strongest of Viltrumites. == Notable Matchups == Victories: Losses: Inconclusive: == References == Category:Tier 4 Category:Tier High 4-C Category:CerberusTheDamned

Although Robot possesses great intelligence, he appears to struggle with social signals, like when he nonchalantly disclosed to the Guardians the unethical way he obtained his cloned body or his failure to grasp Amanda's perspective in their relationship. However, it was later shown that Robot has learned to share himself in more meaningful ways, as he spoke to Amanda about his perspective involving her curse in a way that never made her feel like a problem to be fixed, but a person to be helped. After the emergence of his clone, Robot started performing hero duties in the field instead of the safe distance his original self had previously kept. This placed him in a tough spot since he had rarely had to concern himself with risking his own life previously, and his experience as a hero at that moment felt similar to a video game. (Comic Issue 33) Notable Attacks/Techniques: Fear Manipulation Explanations: If hell and the black abyss being the same thing wasn't obvious enough, Violator is a native of Hell and part of Malebolgia's children, he wants him and the other natives to be the leaders of hell's army instead of the hellspawns, now that this context is established, we can make the connection between the black abyss and hell, by Violator saying he is born in the black abyss. (Comic Issue 15 and 50) In the Spawnverse the more souls you collect, the more powerful you become (Comic Issue 81) in the context of your powers. (Comic Issue 82) Spawn has six thousand souls inside him, and also consumes the people he has killed, layering his abilities to such degrees. (Read justification for multiple souls and absorption.) ===Addressing allegedly antifeats for Spawn: === ==== How can Spawn be faster than light if his teleportation is stated to be speed of light? ==== *Teleportation in Spawnverse doesn't just serve as a way to fast travel, but a way to navigate to and through entities. Al doesn't have to know the actual pathway to a location if he teleports, as the teleportation does that job for him, (Comic Issue 9) it also allows him to go through obstacles that he normally wouldn't be able to. (Comic Issue 11) This ability also works on others, with that giving natural benefits like them also being split into atoms. Overall the teleportation's pros are not only its speed, so that area being negated by Al's faster speed doesn't matter. It's also fair to assume that his teleportation gets faster in the series just like his body does, throughout the series Al keeps learning new aspects of his powers, with that being both physical and mental. ==== He needs weapons that can level a small building to defeat Overtkill. ==== *This was an early Spawn, that hadn't grasped his powers yet, nor had the luxuries of learning more about them like his future self does, there is also a difference in what Al can do in his own mindset and what he can do if he allows K7-Leetha to take over like it did when he erased himself with Angela's angelic lance. ==== Twitch hits Spawn with a bullet. ==== *Twitch is a (Comic Issue 23) sharpshooter (Comic Issue 30) and Al didn't pay any attention to the bullet, he didn't even react when it hit him and just kept running. (Comic Issue 23) ==== Al couldn't react to the nazis' bullet. ==== *Al was poisoned at this time, with this poisoning leaving him badly weakened, (Angela Issue 4) throughout his journey in Alabama he didn't try, (Comic Issue 30) nor did use any energy from his suit. (Comic Issue 31) ==== Al thought that his infiltration mission would take twenty minutes tops. ==== *Al didn't want to use any of his powers, (Comic Issue 55) he also wanted to savor this mission as it links to his past life, making him feel human again. (Comic Issue 55) Al in general loves military related actions, (Comic Issue 138) which is constantly (Comic issue 105) shown throughout the series. (Comic Issue 148) This obviously implies Al holds back when it comes to these situations, so he can savor them. ==== Al went blow for blow with Cy-Gor for ten minutes. ==== *In general, the previous reasoning also applies here, but it's worth mentioning that beasts in Spawn verse have a link with Satan, they are filled with black energy, which can power Al, (Comic Issue 44) these beasts with black energy have feats against angels as well. (Comic Issue 45) ==== Al couldn't react in time to save Twitch from a bullet. ==== *This version of Al is half fused with his wounded human self, meaning that how he used to operate with his dead body isn't the same as this one so it needs rest, (Comic issue 133) not only that but it's stated that Al wasn't as strong as he used to be in this timeperiod, to the point that sensing agony in the city was a new ability for him again, (Comic Issue 128) despite his previous self being able to do this without any effort. He created the Thraxa hybrid army primarily out of desperation after exile rather than careful long-term planning, producing genetically weaker offspring used as disposable forces. In the final battle against Mark he allowed the fight to continue into the Sun, relying on pride and brute strength until he was consumed by it.)

At least Large Planet level (Ripped Thaedus' head from his shoulders. Broke Oliver's arm in his grasp and punched his jaw apart with one blow. Successfully killed Battle Beast, even though the two's battle lasted for days. Battle Beast believes his and Thragg's clashes can tear the planet apart. Easily overpowered Dinosaurus, smashing him through a moon base and cracking open his jaws. Far superior to Omni-Man, Anissa and Conquest, to a point where the latter actually fears him>4.89 Yottatons of TNT) | At least Large Planet level, likely far higher (One-shotted Rognarr's, who could previously rip him apart. Outmatched Allen's forces, being a threat to all of them despite having Post-Colossal Amplification Tech Jacket on his side>>48.9 Yottatons of TNT)

Massively FTL+ (Faster than Invincible and Omni-Man. Caught up to Mark when he was fleeing with stars blurring around them and reacted to Nolan rushing towards them at more than likely full speed to save his son. Can easily dodge Space Racer's infinity ray blasts, which can move fast enough to keep the pace with Mark, Nolan and Thaedus, with Nolan having to pull Mark for him to keep up despite Mark being able to outspeed the fastest spaceship CoP has>130,446,428 c) | Massively FTL+ (Superior to Post-Colossal Amplification Tech Jacket>>1,304,464,280 c)

At least Large Planet level (Withstood blows from Omni-Man. Tanked a bite from Dinosaurus, who was able to effortlessly one-shot Omnipotus) | At least Large Planet level, likely far higher (Survived fighting Invincible inside the sun for some minutes, with the fight already heavily taxing his Smart Atoms)
